description: This source file defines a script for a database patch in an ERP system, specifically for updating the 'Task' doctype. It reloads the doctype, updates property settings to add a 'Completed' option if not already present, and renames the status 'Closed' to 'Completed' in the database.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main entry point for the patch, performs doctype reload, updates property setter, and executes SQL to rename task status.
